contract_summary: Single audio writer confirmed by source. BUT param-namespace is PARTIALLY MISALIGNED: the writer publishes band lanes as Bass/Mid/Treble (+GlobalReactivity) and never writes BassIntensity/MidIntensity/BeatTracker, while every read-only consumer requests BassIntensity and the neural consumer also requests BeatTracker. Only BeatPhase/BeatPulse/BeatIntensity align across writer+all consumers. PIE capture must FAIL on the missing lanes.

single_writer_contract.missing_lane_BassIntensity: requested by consumers, NEVER written by the audio writer (writer uses 'Bass')
single_writer_contract.missing_lane_MidIntensity: requested by CymaticsWriter (fallback exists), NEVER written by the audio writer (writer uses 'Mid')
single_writer_contract.missing_lane_BeatTracker: requested by NeuralHeroMaterialSubsystem, NEVER written by the audio writer

world_field_barometer.status: SCAFFOLD — needs closed-editor Build.bat; offline probe Tools/test_world_field_bus.py

fields.name: WorldPosition
fields.meaning: sample position; Tension falloffs to 0 over 5km

world_field_barometer.note_no_mpc_resonance_tension_params: No MPC-level Resonance/Tension scalar-or-vector parameter was found in source; 'WorldField.Resonance/Tension' are FWorldFieldSample struct/bus fields, not MPC params. Verify against the live MPC asset in PIE.

writers.writes: MPC_Melodia_Palette (audio lanes) — THE sole audio writer
writers.guardrail: single-writer preserved by source; no other system calls SetScalarParameterValue on this collection

writers.writes: MPC_Cymatics_Driver (downstream, SEPARATE collection; sole writer to it)
MPC_Hero_Material (downstream, subsystem-owned; reads audio palette READ-ONLY)

read_only_consumers_of_mpc_melodia_palet.guide: drives Chladni ModeN/ModeM and publishes WorldField.Resonance/Tension; IsReadOnlyByContract=true
mirrors palette to MPC_Cymatics_Driver for cymatic MIs; no palette write

gem_material_consumer.reads: MPC_Hero_Material lanes + WorldField.Resonance/Tension (barometer) per plan §4; read-only
gem_material_consumer.note: Material-level reads can only be proven in PIE via the param-name match table; not verifiable offline.

source_alignment_findings: Path discrepancy: NeuralHeroMaterialSubsystem loads /Game/Melodia/MPC_Melodia_Palette; presentation+cymatics load /Game/Melodia/_PROJECT/04_Materials/MPC_Melodia_Palette. Verify which path the real asset lives at; a wrong load path yields constant defaults.
Writer may be publishing into the wrong collection if the neural path is stale — PIE must assert both assets resolve to the same collection instance.
WorldFieldBus is SCAFFOLD; needs a closed-editor build before PIE can rely on the C++ struct fields.

capture_plan.goal: Prove (a) MPC param names match exactly what materials read, (b) audio bands drive the expected MPC lanes, (c) WorldField.Resonance/Tension barometer moves on a beat.

assertions.shape: param-name match table: for each lane in the union {writer params} x {consumer reads}, record writer_publishes bool, consumer_reads bool, aligned bool. PASS iff all consumer-requested names are in the writer's publish set.
assertions.expected: Currently EXPECTED FAIL on BassIntensity, MidIntensity, BeatTracker (writer publishes Bass/Mid/Treble instead).

assertions.shape: amplitude response: capture concurrent time series of bass/mid/treble power (or MusicClock phase) and each MPC scalar over >=4 bars; assert monotone positive correlation of band->lane per the intended mapping.
assertions.expected: Bass band -> Bass lane; beat onset -> BeatPulse spike; BeatPhase wraps 1->0 on beat. Re-run after writer lane alignment.

assertions.shape: sample UWorldFieldBus::SampleResonanceTension at plate centre each frame; assert Tension>0 for a beat containing a pulse (BeatPulse>0 forces amplitude floor 0.15), and ResonanceN/M track the bass-driven mode growth.
assertions.expected: Tension follows Chladni amp Abs(cos-...)*max(BeatPulse,0.15); ResonanceN climbs 2->clamp(2+floor(Bass*6),1,8) as bass lane rises.

run_step.when: after single editor lock released (owner is the current 9316 holder), open L_PCG_Hero_CrystalHarpGrove, confirm MusicClock HasMusicalTime, start PIE, drive a score, capture windowed JSON + MP4 for >=1 phrase, write to the save paths.
